notes.title: Bug Fixes & Small Game Changes
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:

 Fixed a bug where player would stuck in collision
 Fixed few lightnig bugs which weren't backed correctly
 Fixed a bug where interactive items could not be picked up correctly
 Fixed a small bug where player could glitch into meshes


Game Changes

 Added more zombies to the abandoned city level
 Added more interactive items to the abandoned city level
 Added reflection probes to make the level look darker
 Added more interactive items to the asylum map

notes.title: BIG UPDATE The Purification v0.2
notes.notes:
Over the past few months there has been a beta branch running with regular experimental updates. With these updates the game has been fixed, optimised and changed in various ways to improve the gameplay for everyone.

Some of these changes are quite significant however these changes are made to improve the overall gameplay experience. This update now puts the game into a much more stable state which will allow for new content to start being worked on.

Changes

 Better Graphics
 New Maps
 A lot of bug fixes
 New Player
 Better Zombie AI


A very big update, bringing The Purification to another level!
Stayed tuned for new content to be released very soon!

If you experience any issues with your save file after this update please feel free to report bugs: 
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1463050/discussions/
